author: NPR Music
description:
We brought the magic of our iconic concerts to San Francisco with the one-of-a-kind Tiny Desk Experience for Super Bowl Weekend, sponsored by Levi’s. The result was extraordinary❗️⁠
⁠
Goapele, P-Lo, Souls of Mischief and 2025 Tiny Desk Contest winner, Ruby Ibarra, delivered intimate performances that showcased Bay Area creativity and community. 🤩⁠
⁠
👀 What city do you think deserves a Tiny Desk Experience?
title: We brought the magic of our iconic concerts to San Francisco with the Tiny Desk Experience❗️⁠
